title: Recover inheritance variability from nonzero-lag noisy lineage moments
statement: In the independent random-affine birth-size model, the observed polynomial lag matrices equal the latent M_k at nonzero lags despite unknown iid additive measurement noise. M1^-1 M2 has eigenvalues E[R] and E[R^2], so Var(R)=q-a^2.

requires: finite fourth moments and invertible degree-two covariance
assumptions: iid (R,Delta) pairs independent of the current size/past
iid observation errors independent of entire latent process
not zero-lag covariance; not correlated segmentation noise
costs: finite-sample estimation error increases with observation noise
no raw biological dataset analyzed in source
contract.units: size moments up to fourth order; pencil eigenvalues dimensionless
contract.obstruction: Separates partition variability from independent sensor noise without claiming a unique biochemical mechanism or universal cell law.

review.scope: Exact source-supported extraction only; any scoped substantive acceptance is a separate version-bound review overlay.
